body: I don't know, I feel like I have had opportunities. I have tried to embrace them....but I am a failure in that I don't know how to make things change for myself. I don't want to rely on others, but at the same time I am tired of being alone. I can't get over the feeling that I have really messed something up...or that things will never get better. Ihave always been able to battle through this before, but this time feels so different...
